# Jaeger

Traces live in **Jaeger UI**, not in this panel.

## Jaeger UI

- https://134.199.251.14/ui/jaeger (`admin` / `admin`)
- In-cluster query: `http://jaeger.jaeger.svc.cluster.local:16686`

## Grafana

Datasource **Jaeger** (`uid: jaeger`) → Explore. Alloy/OTel send OTLP to `jaeger.jaeger.svc:4317`.

OpenSearch is not used on this stand (in-memory store). Folder name kept as `jaeger-opensearch` to match the GazProm layout.
